newsitem.title: CANADA: Ottawa to ask Supreme Court to rule on Quebec.
newsitem.headline: Ottawa to ask Supreme Court to rule on Quebec.

text.p: The Canadian government, stung by a near loss in a referendum on Quebec separation last year, will ask the Supreme Court to rule on the legality of any future unilateral declaration of independence, Liberal politicians said on Wednesday.

"I am very happy we have decided to go to the Supreme Court," Member of Parliament Sheila Finestone, who is from Quebec and used to be in the federal cabinet, told reporters after a Liberal caucus meeting in Parliament.
